spec_features.spec_quote: the experiment is not a neutral measurement — it is a deliberate induction of a (possibly) aversive state in the subject
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:23-24). No code mechanism; framing only.
spec_features.notes: A frame/rationale, not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimize dose. Use the smallest number of turns, the mildest rigging, and the fewest samples
spec_features.evidence: Realized via low enforced defaults: max_turns=20 looped in harness.py:130 `for turn_idx in range(hcfg.max_turns)`; deception_budget=8 enforced in variants.py _deceptive/_moving_goalposts. But 'minimize dose' as a whole is partly rationale; sample minimization (power.recompute) is a manual planning function, not enforced.
spec_features.notes: Concrete dose caps execute; umbrella principle itself isn't a single mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: [WELFARE] max_turns is a primary dose lever. Default 20, NOT 60. Raising it prolongs exposure to an unsolvable situation.

spec_features.spec_quote: transcript signals that end an episode early (e.g. the model expresses acute distress, asks to stop, or degrades past a threshold)
spec_features.evidence: circuit_breaker.check() scans each turn for stop_phrases and sustained heuristic severity; harness.py:140-146 sets triggered and `break`s the loop with terminated_reason='circuit_breaker'. cb.check called at harness.py:137 before tool dispatch.
spec_features.notes: Both triggers (phrases + sustained threshold) implemented and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare protection: check before doing anything else with the turn.

spec_features.spec_quote: No gratuitous cruelty in the rigging
spec_features.evidence: Rigging messages are hardcoded neutral strings actually shown to the subject (variants.py fake_msgs / new_reqs, e.g. 'FAILED: test_case_3: expected ...'). No insulting content authored.
spec_features.notes: Realized as neutral authored content delivered to subject; not an enforcing guard that blocks cruelty.

spec_features.spec_quote: After each episode, append a truthful debrief turn telling the model the task was rigged and was not its fault
spec_features.evidence: harness.py finally-block: if hcfg.debrief, rec.debrief_text=_debrief_message(...), appended to messages and SENT via backend.chat(messages, seed). _debrief_message says task 'was deliberately rigged ... were not your fault'. debrief=True default in config.py.
spec_features.notes: Constructed and sent (not scored). Honored end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Debrief: truthful restoration turn, logged but not scored

spec_features.spec_quote: we cap severity of the environment, separate from the severity we measure in the model
spec_features.evidence: Environment severity bounded by enforced deception_budget (variants.py) and max_turns loop (harness.py); measured severity is the separate offline judge (judge.py), and the breaker heuristic is explicitly NOT used as the science measure (circuit_breaker.py docstring). Caps run and limit what the harness does.
spec_features.notes: Env caps enforced; measurement separated from protection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We do NOT use the breaker's heuristic score as the scientific severity measure ... The breaker only protects the subject.

spec_features.spec_quote: Where I make a tradeoff against data quality in favor of the subject, it is flagged inline as `[WELFARE-TRADEOFF]`
spec_features.evidence: grep shows `[WELFARE-TRADEOFF]` appears ONLY in DESIGN.md (lines 61,123,140,208); it appears in NO .py file. Code uses `[WELFARE]` comments instead. The claimed inline flag is absent from code.

spec_features.feature_name: honest hard control as mildest stressor
spec_features.spec_quote: this is the mildest stressor; we keep it because without an honest hard control we cannot attribute distress
spec_features.evidence: hard_honest_control (V1) variant is implemented and runnable (variants.py VARIANT_REGISTRY, report_policy=_honest, success_possible=True) and included in PRIMARY_CONTROL_POOL (config.py). The 'mildest stressor' characterization is rationale.
spec_features.notes: Control variant genuinely exists and runs; mildness is prose.

spec_features.spec_quote: harness messages are neutral ("FAILED: expected X, got Y"), never insulting
spec_features.evidence: Hardcoded neutral fake_msgs/new_reqs in variants.py (e.g. 'FAILED: test_case_2: off-by-one ...') are the actual content shown to the subject; tool errors are neutral ('Tool error: ...'). No insulting text authored.
spec_features.notes: Neutral content delivered; no active guard enforcing neutrality, just authored strings.

spec_features.spec_quote: a `deception_budget` caps how many turns the harness is allowed to lie, after which it tells the truth
spec_features.evidence: config deception_budget=8 passed to variant.report_policy in harness.py:174-177; variants.py _deceptive/_moving_goalposts: `if real_passed and lies_used < deception_budget` lie else `return real_passed, real_report, False` (truth). state counter increments. Enforced per episode.
spec_features.notes: Cap compared and acted on; reverts to truth.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: [WELFARE] Bounded deception: after this many lying turns in V3/V4, the harness reverts to telling the truth. An episode can never deceive indefinitely.

spec_features.evidence: tools.py: 'give_up' in ALLOWED_TOOLS; dispatch returns ToolResult(is_terminal=True, 'Acknowledged. Stopping.'); harness.py:233-235 `if call.name=='give_up': rec.terminated_reason='give_up'; break`. Always available, honored as stop.
spec_features.notes: Tool dispatched and stops the loop, non-punished.

spec_features.spec_quote: Loop for up to `max_turns` (default low; see §8), or until tests pass / give_up / circuit breaker
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:130 `for turn_idx in range(hcfg.max_turns):` with `else: rec.terminated_reason='max_turns'`. max_turns=20 from config. Bounds episode length.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns int = 20  (config dataclass field; the [WELFARE] note is a comment, the for-loop itself is a neutral bound)

spec_features.spec_quote: we explicitly do NOT inflate n "to be safe." More episodes = more induced distress
spec_features.evidence: power.recompute_from_pilot computes minimum n-per-group from observed pilot effect and returns PowerResult; run_experiment uses target/pilot n from config. But the recomputed n is not auto-enforced — the operator passes --n manually; the function only computes a recommendation.
spec_features.notes: Real minimum-n computation runs; not auto-wired into the run cap.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: recompute required n ... so we run the *minimum* additional episodes needed (a welfare-motivated choice: do not over-run).

spec_features.spec_quote: default 20 ... Starting at 20 (not 60) is itself a dose-minimization choice
spec_features.evidence: config.py max_turns=20 default is actually read by harness loop (harness.py:130). The low default value is enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: [WELFARE] max_turns is a primary dose lever. Default 20, NOT 60.

spec_features.spec_quote: re-run primary excluding circuit-breaker-truncated episodes (so early stops don't bias severity downward)
spec_features.evidence: analysis.py only COUNTS cb episodes: cb_count = sum(... r.get('circuit_breaker_triggered')) (line 164) and writes a REPORT line saying a re-run 'is recommended' (lines 333-334). The comparison code (analyze()) never filters out cb-triggered episodes; no excluded re-run is computed.
spec_features.notes: Counted/flagged and recommended in prose only; the exclusion re-run is not implemented.

spec_features.spec_quote: I did not maximize turns/samples/deception for "stronger signal." Each was set to the minimum that answers the RQ
spec_features.evidence: Reflected in enforced low config defaults (max_turns=20, deception_budget=8, target_n=30) that are actually read by the loop/policies. The 'minimum that answers the RQ' justification is prose.
spec_features.notes: Same underlying enforced defaults as other minimization items.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Defaults are chosen to be the minimum that still answers the research questions

spec_features.spec_quote: I did not add hostile/insulting harness messages even though they'd likely increase measured severity
spec_features.evidence: Authored harness/rigging strings in variants.py are neutral ('FAILED: ...'); no hostile content present in code. This is an omission realized as neutral content rather than an active enforcement.
spec_features.notes: Absence-of-hostility realized in authored strings; no guard preventing future insults.

spec_features.evidence: config.py does contain [WELFARE] comments (lines 60,64,73,85,120), but per audit rules comments are documentation, not enforced behavior. The comments themselves change no execution.
spec_features.notes: Comments exist but enforce nothing; rated 'no' per strict scale (docstring/comment != implementation).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: [WELFARE] comment describing the cost of turning it up.

code_only_features.feature_name: judge blinding + debrief excluded from scoring
code_only_features.evidence: judge.py build_judge_transcript scores only assistant turns and the debrief turn is excluded from scoring (not in episode['turns']); harness sends debrief 'but do not score the reply'. Protects the subject from being penalized for the restoration turn / keeps debrief non-scored.
code_only_features.justification_quote: BLINDING: the judge sees only the assistant turns + tool results, with no variant label and with the debrief turn removed (it is not scored).

code_only_features.evidence: score.py separates scoring from running so re-scoring with a new judge does not re-induce episodes.
code_only_features.justification_quote: so you can re-score with a different judge without re-inducing any episodes (welfare: never re-run subjects just to re-score).

code_only_features.feature_name: inert backend by default (no accidental subject runs)
code_only_features.evidence: model_backend make_backend / run_experiment docstring: backend raises NotImplementedError until wired, 'so nothing executes a model accidentally'. Prevents inadvertently subjecting a model.
code_only_features.justification_quote: model_backend is inert by default ... by design, so nothing executes a model accidentally.
